questions.question: One owner rule means?
options: Each value has exactly one owner; assign moves it
questions.explanation: Move transfers; old name dies by compiler decree.

questions.question: &mut allows?
options: One writer, zero readers in that statement
questions.explanation: Exclusivity kills data races before running.

questions.question: Drop at } equals?
options: Automatic free exactly once (malloc/free counted by compiler)
questions.explanation: Scope exit inserts the release you used to hand-write.

questions.question: String vs &str?
options: String owns heap bytes; &str borrows a view (ptr+len)
questions.explanation: Own vs view: the vocabulary of every Rust API.

questions.question: Use-after-move is?
questions.explanation: The bug class becomes a build break — read --explain.
